steps: Jump to steps Acepyr Airdrop Details No Acepyr airdrop has been announced. The company’s terms are blunt: testnet $ACEPYR is a symbolic point system with no economic value, it cannot be bought, and it may never be worth anything. Acepyr intends to bridge testnet contributions to a mainnet $ACEPYR ownership token, but no ratio has been set and it reserves the right to cancel that plan. Treat participation as free positioning, not an investment. What the platform pays now is measurable. Twenty one
off faucet achievements pay 50 to 1,000 testnet $ACEPYR each, credited automatically at sign
in with no claim button. A weekly pool of 10,000 is split pro

rata by settled trading volume among everyone who traded that week, though that pool is recorded rather than paid for now. Testnet V2.0.2 shipped on 4 September 2026, putting real testnet $ACEPYR on Base Sepolia and opening deposit and redeem routes between your wallet and your platform balance.
